title: Elegant Interior + Private Pool + Foodie Paradise
description:
Our freshly updated 1930s bungalow blends Nashville’s rich heritage with contemporary yet tasteful flair -- the only cliché cowboy kitsch here is the private cowboy tub (and some cool art)!

Kick back in the bespoke, cheerful interiors; unwind in the tranquil, private backyard (complete with private karaoke room!); sip coffee on either porch; head to the park for a pickleball battle (we provide gear); or explore any of TEN award-winning culinary destinations less than 100 steps from our door.

The space
Inside you'll find a cozy living room with a SmartTV, two bedrooms (1 King + 1 Queen) each with a vanity/desk + closet, and a completely rebuilt spa-like bathroom featuring a luxurious soaking tub. 

The kitchen is fully equipped with cookware, a bistro table, fridge, oven, microwave, dishwasher, and multiple coffee preparation devices for fellow caffeine aficionados. 

Outside enjoy a front porch swing, secluded covered back patio with lounge seating, dining area, fire pit, private karaoke lounge, dipping pool, and sun loungers — perfect for relaxing day through night.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home including the front and rear fenced in yard areas.

Other things to note
- We provide pickleball and tennis gear for guests upon request.

- There is private on-residence parking accessed from the alley in the rear for up to 4 vehicles. 

- We are professional event organizers by trade. If interested in throwing a soirée or shindig here, reach out to see how we can best accommodate.
